audit_type: AI-assisted bibliographic identity and cited-result scope assessment

scope: Source identity, metadata, cited roles and documented statement scope. Full source-proof certification is a distinct form of evidence.

AOV Project Euclid page returned non-text iframe; the author’s publication-list PDF supplied journal pages, versioned author arXiv supplied the common-base claim.

Some publisher DOI/landing URLs intermittently returned internal errors or sparse text: ACM Dyer, IEEE Gopalan, CUP Greenhill, some Elsevier/Wiley variants. Original papers/author records and deposited metadata supplied the missing fields; the ledger identifies each source type.
